paper_title: Search for ultralight scalar dark matter with atomic spectroscopy
notes: Scalar (dilaton-like) DM coupling d_e to photons inducing alpha oscillations, constrained via Dy spectroscopy of near-degenerate levels. 95% CL. Best limit d_e ~ 4.2e-8 at m_phi ~ 1e-22 eV; exceeds EP tests below 3e-18 eV (EP limit ~3.6e-4). Data points reconstructed from Fig. 4 and text anchors: minimum at 1e-22 eV, low-mass side scales as ~m^-1 (amplitude ω^-2), high-mass side scales ~m due to κφ0∝1/m. Exact plotted curve approximate.
